correctness.rationale: The birational actions are derived by renormalizing five markings. In affine blow-up charts their equalizer ideals are explicitly eliminated with denominator unit resultants. The ten (-1)-boundary component incidence enumeration excludes missed support, and local swap charts exclude hidden boundary thickening. In characteristic two u³ and the ideal (a,b)(a+b) prove both distinct nilpotent forms. Exact symbolic checker confirms group relations, ideals, boundary permutations, and field examples. No finite experiment is used to prove an infinite assertion.

value.rationale: The two naturally remaining 2-primary conjugacy types of S5 automorphisms on the quintic del Pezzo surface exhibit genuinely different wild fixed-scheme phenomena: flat curvilinear collision of a finite fixed scheme and collision of a fixed curve with an isolated section carrying an embedded nilpotent. These integrally refined local and field-arithmetic results cannot be read off from automorphism group tables, and give a coherent complete classification for the two types rather than an arbitrary coefficient slice.
